answers.q1: Yarn v1 (classic), pinned as yarn@1.22.22 in package.json's packageManager field. The repo is a Yarn workspaces monorepo that needs Node >=18, and CI uses Node 20.x. Install dependencies with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:unit --watch=false  (this runs vitest once. CI runs plain `yarn test:unit`, which exits on its own without a TTY. `yarn test:all` also runs types, lint and format checks first.)
answers.q4: CI (.github/workflows/lint.yml) runs these three in order after `yarn install`: yarn test:format && yarn test:lint && yarn test:types. These expand to: prettier "**/*.{css,scss,json,md,html,yml}" --ignore-path=.eslintignore --list-different, then eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx ., then tsc. To auto-fix, run `yarn fix`.
answers.q5: The ignore lists in .eslintignore (.prettierignore is empty) name these generated or vendored paths: node_modules/, build/, dist/, dev-dist/, coverage/, public/workbox, packages/excalidraw/types, examples/**/public, and firebase/. Don't hand-edit them. yarn.lock is also machine-generated, so change it only through yarn. I didn't check whether other generated files exist, such as locale coverage output. I also didn't check whether the packages/fractional-indexing and packages/laser-pointer folders are vendored code.
